inspiration: DBS digibank app screenshots supplied by the user (Home, Change Card Linkage, More), colours sampled from pixels

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The red of the app: badge dots, NEW pills, icons on tiles, outlined pill borders, large CTA labels. White text on it is only 3.8:1, so use brand-strong for button fills with 14–16px labels.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and red text links (4.7:1 with white). Bottom of the hero gradient.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Top of the hero gradient; pressed state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Round quick-action tile fill; ghost button hover.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Faint pink tint at the top of the white sheet that sits over the hero.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Navy ink: titles, amounts, row text, and the bottom tab bar fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Card headings such as 'Deposits' (11:1 on card).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: tile labels, captions, section band text, 'Settled' (6:1 on card, 5.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: The app's light grey for 'SGD' prefixes and 'Available balance'. Only 3.5:1 on card: use for 18px+ text or decoration only (flagged from the app).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and tile borders, list dividers, input borders.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Neutral count chip behind numbers like 'Deposits 2'.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grey page background and section bands ('QUICK ACCESS').

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, headers, icon tiles.

tokens.name: tab-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive tab icons and labels on the ink tab bar (5.2:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-strong, the hero and the tab bar's active item.

tokens.name: owe
tokens.usage: 'You owe SGD X'. Always paired with the words, never colour alone (5.2:1 on card).

tokens.name: owed
tokens.usage: 'You are owed SGD X', settled check icons (5.5:1 on card).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button fill; label stays on-brand at reduced opacity.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banner fill.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Info banner border.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info banner text (9:1).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill, e.g. first-time payee.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Warning banner border.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning banner text (9:1).

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner fill, e.g. receipt mismatch.

tokens.name: error-line
tokens.usage: Error banner border.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error banner text (9:1).

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success banner fill.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Success banner border.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success banner text (9:1).

tokens.name: avatar-amy
tokens.usage: Demo member avatar (seed data). White initials 4.7:1.

tokens.name: avatar-ben
tokens.usage: Demo member avatar. White initials 5.2:1.

tokens.name: avatar-cal
tokens.usage: Demo member avatar. Darkened from the seed's #059669 (3.8:1) to pass at 5.5:1.

tokens.name: avatar-dee
tokens.usage: Demo member avatar. Darkened from the seed's #d97706 (3.2:1) to pass at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: avatar-eve
tokens.usage: Demo member avatar. White initials 5.7:1.

tokens.name: avatar-unknown
tokens.usage: Avatar when the member is unknown (4.8:1).

styles.name: balance
styles.usage: Hero amounts on cards; preceded by a 16px 'SGD' in subtle. Tabular figures.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Centred header title with a back chevron.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headings ('Deposits', group names) in ink-2.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and smaller cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start splitting with confidence, netted for you

styles.name: row-value
styles.usage: Selected value in a list row, under a caption.

styles.name: tile-label
styles.usage: Quick-action and grid tile labels in muted, centred, max two lines.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Uppercase band headings in muted on surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Caption to value gap; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and badge; tile icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side gutter; row side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Hero side padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above section bands; hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Primary CTA (the app's squared-off NEXT button).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, icon grid tiles, inputs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of the white sheet over the hero; bottom tab bar corners.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: Phone frame corners in demos.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Quick-action discs, avatars, pills (LOG OUT, NEW), count chips.

tokens.usage: Cards on the sheet, alongside a line border.
